name: VisuallyHidden
rungReason: There is no native element for text that's read but not shown; clipping keeps it in the accessibility tree where hidden or display: none would not.
covers: The focusable variant: it shows while something inside has focus

a11y.role: none: its text joins the accessible name or description around it
a11y.name: n/a

keyboard.action: Passes over it: nothing here takes focus

focus.indicator: Shown while something inside it has focus (:focus-within), so a focusable child is never invisible

rules: Only for text that adds to what's on screen ("Error: ", ", opens in a new tab"), never to hide content sighted users need
